title: YouTuber Cliff Tan says ignoring AI is 'irresponsible' despite backlash
excerpt: YouTube creator Cliff Tan apologized to angry fans after he promoted AI on his channel. Tan, however, says designers should learn the technology.
content_html:
YouTube star Cliff Tan apologized for promoting AI, but he doesn't regret it.

Tan, who came under intense backlash from fans after he posted a paid promotion for an AI company on Monday, told Business Insider that, like it or not, interior designers need to learn to use AI if they want to secure future work.

"You can't just avoid it forever," Tan said. "The industry is using it. You need to embrace it if you don't want to be out of a job."

Tan is based in London and runs a popular interior design YouTube channel called "Dear Modern" that has 2.4 million subscribers. He also runs a corresponding TikTok account with 3.6 million followers.

Though Tan apologized for the paid ad — which promoted Dreamina, a Chinese AI company owned by TikTok creator ByteDance — he didn't take it down from his channel. He told Business Insider that as an influencer, he wouldn't feel right ignoring AI's potential uses in architecture and interior design.

"I thought it was a bit irresponsible for me to just sweep AI under the carpet," he said.

In the ad, Tan uploads hand-drawn sketches to Dreamina and then uses the platform to transform them into an animated floor plan.

Tan said he took great pains to show his audience he wasn't blindly using the program to generate ideas, but rather to quicken what would otherwise be a lengthy process of rendering an animation.

The backlash came anyway.

"cliff no dont give in to the ai slop," one commenter wrote. "No, Mr. Cliff. Please. Don't sell yourself to AI," another wrote. That one has 1,800 likes.

Tan said he expected some negative comments, but not the tsunami that he ultimately received. "They felt like, 'oh, I am not the same as before,'" he said. "When they saw me jump on the bandwagon, they were very disappointed."

Dreamina, Tan said, initially wanted him to make the ad with a lot more pro-AI sentiment. Tan said he negotiated with the company to make an ad that was more "true to my followers" by incorporating his own doubts about AI into the video.

"I should say that you can use it, but only in the right way," Tan recalled thinking.

Creators of all kinds are increasingly coming under fire from their audiences for using AI. Hank Green, who makes educational videos about science and other subjects and is one of the internet's most reliable content creators, apologized to fans last week for relying on AI "too heavily" when researching his videos. He later shared a new AI policy for his channel.

In the world of influencers, where authenticity and quirkiness are necessary to maintain devoted audiences, the perception that a creator is using AI can damage their reputation and brand.

Tan, who described himself as "really, really analog," said he doesn't anticipate AI ever playing a role in how he makes his videos. He didn't, however, rule out future AI endorsements.

"If I see that it's valuable to incorporate the use of AI in the industry or to educate people in a way that is positive for their growth, I might," he said.

content_html_zh:
YouTube 明星 Cliff Tan 为推广人工智能而道歉，但他并不后悔。

周一，谭在发布一家人工智能公司的付费促销信息后遭到了粉丝的强烈反对，他告诉《商业内幕》，无论你喜欢与否，室内设计师如果想确保未来的工作，就需要学习使用人工智能。

“你不能永远避免它，”谭说。 “业界正在使用它。 如果你不想失业，你就需要接受它。”

Tan 居住在伦敦，经营着一个名为“Dear Modern”的流行室内设计 YouTube 频道，该频道拥有 240 万订阅者。 他还运营着一个相应的 TikTok 账户，拥有 360 万粉丝。

尽管谭为这则付费广告道歉——该广告宣传了 TikTok 创建者字节跳动旗下的一家中国人工智能公司 Dreamina——但他并没有将其从自己的频道中删除。 他告诉《商业内幕》，作为一名有影响力的人，他认为忽视人工智能在建筑和室内设计中的潜在用途是不对的。

“我认为将人工智能掩盖起来有点不负责任，”他说。

在广告中，Tan 将手绘草图上传到 Dreamina，然后使用该平台将其转换为动画平面图。

谭说，他煞费苦心地向观众展示，他并不是盲目地使用该程序来产生想法，而是为了加快动画渲染的漫长过程。

无论如何，反弹还是来了。

一位评论者写道：“悬崖，不，不要向人工智能屈服。” “不，克里夫先生。 请。 不要把自己卖给人工智能，”另一位写道。 那个有 1,800 个赞。

谭说，他预计会出现一些负面评论，但不会是他最终收到的海啸。 “他们感觉，‘哦，我和以前不一样了，’”他说。 “当他们看到我跟风时，他们非常失望。”

谭说，Dreamina 最初希望他制作的广告带有更多支持人工智能的情绪。 谭说，他与该公司协商，通过将自己对人工智能的怀疑融入到视频中，制作一则更“忠于我的追随者”的广告。

“我应该说你可以使用它，但只能以正确的方式使用它，”谭回忆道。

各类创作者因使用人工智能而越来越受到观众的批评。 制作有关科学和其他主题的教育视频的汉克·格林 (Hank Green) 是互联网上最可靠的内容创作者之一，他上周因在研究他的视频时“过于依赖”人工智能而向粉丝道歉。 后来他分享了他频道的新人工智能政策。

在有影响力的世界里，真实性和古怪性对于维持忠实的受众来说是必要的，而创作者使用人工智能的看法可能会损害他们的声誉和品牌。

谭称自己“非常非常模拟”，他表示，他预计人工智能不会在他制作视频的过程中发挥作用。 不过，他并不排除未来人工智能的支持。

他说：“如果我认为将人工智能的应用融入行业或以有利于人们成长的方式教育人们是有价值的，我可能会这么做。”
